residual_risks: The 60 m neighbor-candidate pruning has zero observed eta_sb difference in 12 stratified full-field comparisons, but this is empirical coverage rather than an exhaustive geometric proof for all mirror-state pairs.
The ideal planar-mirror model excludes slope, surface, and tracking errors because the problem provides no corresponding parameters.
The 4.65 mrad uniform pillbox and equal weighting of the 60 prescribed states are approved simplifying assumptions, not site-measured distributions.
Receiver-center aiming is not a global optimization of receiver aimpoints or flux uniformity.
